description: A pair of fixed foot-contact positions on the authored base. Stance 1 defines foot placement only.

footContactTargets.authority: Use the two visible foot-contact points in lockedReview; the previous female reference and its coordinates are superseded.

rules: When the user requests stance 1, both ground-contact points must land on these base-normalized targets.
Stance 1 does not define or constrain torso angle, knee bend, hand position, gesture, expression, clothing, silhouette, or overall body pose.
Character height, species scale, leg length, foot size, or body width must not move the contact targets.
Goliath and Dragonborn use the same stance-1 contact targets as human-scale figures.
Scale and translate the complete whole-figure cutout to satisfy both targets; do not warp or repaint a locked figure.
If a generated pose cannot satisfy both targets without distortion, reject it as incompatible with stance 1.
The selected figure source and locked review composite must remain unchanged.
